versions.prompt: DIRECTION 02 poster 1: completely new contemporary editorial family campaign. cobalt #3048CF background, white headline, peach #FFC7AA large disk, lilac accents. Flat oversized geometric disks, broad color blocks, subtle paper grain, confident negative space. No arches, gold ornament, gradients or old Reem Kufi font. Layout: headline centered y170 in 2 lines; support y425; screenshot offset RIGHT x290 y590 width700 height1245; left margin has large chapter number and small category text; logo top60. Arabic Noto Naskh bold headline90px, support36px via @font-face https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/brand-assets/talia-naskh-font/NotoNaskhArabic-VariableFont_wght.ttf. EXACT headline: رفيقك اليومي / مع القرآن. EXACT support: قراءة وحفظ وورد يومي في تجربة واحدة. Small category: الرئيسية. Exact screenshot img: https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/137128afc035f2c9ebb2ab10faaf43fb5c74564271fd851b104a2e3d51fc95c0/18-home-updated.png. Preserve img original pixels and ratio, entire image visible, no transforms/tilt/crops/overlays on screenshot; image may have32px corners, thin white border, subtle offset shadow. Original logo as supplied. Editable HTML text, fixed1080x1920, all content within60px safe margins. No fabricated Quran or UI. Style must be visibly different from green first collection, coordinated with other direction02 posters.

Replace rejected cobalt/peach circular editorial composition with a premium cinematic app-store poster. Fixed1080x1920. Charcoal #171A1D and warm white #FAF6F0, restrained burnished copper #C68B62. No blue, purple, peach disks, arches, chapter numbers or decorative shapes. Sophisticated tangible matte charcoal material, subtle directional light. Original logo top-right small in brandrow. Large beautifully set bold Arabic Noto Naskh headline white, right-aligned at x90 y160 width900, two lines EXACT: رفيقك اليومي / مع القرآن. Exact support below: قراءة وحفظ وورد يومي في تجربة واحدة. Actual screenshot presented in a premium straight-on graphite phone frame with realistic thin metal edge and soft shadow, centered x175 y565 width730, entire screenshot visible at original ratio; no tilt and no notch covering content. Phone bottom within1880. Warm narrow copper light behind phone edges, dark typography field. Refined large typography, clear hierarchy and optical spacing, high contrast, no crowded decorations. Exact screenshot img https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/137128afc035f2c9ebb2ab10faaf43fb5c74564271fd851b104a2e3d51fc95c0/18-home-updated.png; preserve every UI and Quran pixel. Use actual @font-face Noto Naskh Arabic from https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/brand-assets/talia-naskh-font/NotoNaskhArabic-VariableFont_wght.ttf, font-weight700 headline92px. Editable HTML headlines. No copyright, numbered chapter, buttons or invented claims. This must feel like a premium product launch campaign and completely different from rejected poster.

Recompose poster to closely follow the uploaded Golden Quran STORE SCREENSHOT reference's art direction: warm ivory #FFFCF2 paper, very faint thin champagne-gold eight-point Islamic geometric repeat across background, simple dark-brown Arabic headline, large floating app screenshots arranged at gentle angles with subtle warm shadows. This is Talia's own campaign, never use competitor UI or text in output. Fixed1080x1920. Exact headline two lines at top centered x80 y120 width920, Noto Naskh Arabic medium78px: اقرأ بتأنٍّ / واستمع. Exact support centered below at y330, dark muted brown36px: مصحف واضح وتلاوة من داخل الصفحة. Original Talia logo small64px and brand name bottom at y1820, no other labels or English copy. Primary exact img https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/2866b701e660781d85b20661e3b6c833bbaf395805c5a429eea63820821892fc/04-reader-clean.png at x310 y550 width660 natural height1173, rotate(-7deg), radius20px, subtle warm shadow; whole primary img visible inside canvas and above all secondary images, no phone frame/notch or metallic device. Secondary exact img https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/eacb608c7cd2769a9151e76dbcd3e1bc708d9383a19c78be770758a025a69f77/02-quran-index.png at x-35 y850 width440 naturalheight782 rotate(12deg), BEHIND primary, partially off left edge like reference. Keep Quran region fully visible, no overlays on it and no image rewriting. All screenshot pixels remain exact with only uniform scaling/rotation. Original logo exact project brand asset. Pattern is delicate linework with low6percent opacity, never overpower screenshots. All copy editable HTML. Use @font-face Noto Naskh Arabic src https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/brand-assets/talia-naskh-font/NotoNaskhArabic-VariableFont_wght.ttf. No prior charcoal/cobalt/disks/arches/chapter numbers/CTA/copyright. Aim for the airy cream-gold heritage look and lively overlapping screenshots seen in user reference.

Refine this partially accepted warm ivory heritage marketing concept, NOT a new direction. User specifically requests same font as FIRST campaign: actual Reem Kufi Variable from @font-face src https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/brand-assets/talia-arabic-font/ReemKufi-Variable.ttf, family 'Reem Kufi', use for headline/support/brand. Headline bold86px (weight700), lineheight1.3, clean Arabic shaping. Exact headline two lines: اقرأ بتأنٍّ / واستمع. Exact support: مصحف واضح وتلاوة من داخل الصفحة. Retain ivory #FFFCF2, deep olive-brown #3D3425 copy, subtle champagne #C4A365 thin EIGHT POINT star tessellation, about9percent opacity, more defined than previous nearly invisible pattern but restrained. Develop composition: tighter header hierarchy and spacing, stronger screenshot focal point, more generous consistent margins. Brand logo64px with name تالية القرآن in small horizontal row top-right x740 y65; headline right-aligned x100 y175 width880 and support y425; small thin gold divider beneath. Main exact reader img https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/2866b701e660781d85b20661e3b6c833bbaf395805c5a429eea63820821892fc/04-reader-clean.png should be dominant, floating at x260 y660 width750 rotated-5deg, rounded22px and warm soft shadow. To remove its excessive blank top margin: display original screenshot inside a width750 height1000 overflow-hidden crop wrapper, with full-width natural-ratio img shifted up by333px (=480 native pixels). This crops only toolbar/blank upper region; all Quran ornament, all seven verses, ayah numbers, full basmala and page footer must remain inside crop. DO NOT regenerate or edit image pixels. Secondary exact index img https://vgbujcuwptvheqijyjbe.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/hmac-uploads/projects/1e8d0a36-f2e3-4302-b966-9a9a009d58e9/content-assets/eacb608c7cd2769a9151e76dbcd3e1bc708d9383a19c78be770758a025a69f77/02-quran-index.png behind at x-45 y870 width480 naturalheight853 rotated+9deg; overlap main only from behind, never cover Quran. Secondary bottom and primary bottom make dynamic balanced spread. Bottom simple brand line at y1840, no fake pills/claims/icons/CTA, no English. No full phone frame or notch, no arcs or colored disks. Flat screenshot scaling/rotation, no image fade/gradient over screenshot. All text editable HTML, fixed1080x1920. Compared to previous concept, actual Quran should be noticeably larger and nearer the top of its card. Keep main image entirely within canvas except secondary edge crop. Use exactly original uploaded logo. Preserve current accepted warm reference aesthetic.
